paper.title_en: Corrections to Hawking radiation from asteroid-mass primordial black holes: analytic and numerical evaluation of the stochastic charge effect
paper.abstract_en: Hawking radiation sets stringent constraints on Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) as a dark matter candidate in the $M\sim 10^{16}$ g regime based on the evaporation products produced by the black hole, motivating the need to rigorously model the photon, electron, and positron emission spectra. This manuscript is the second in a series of two papers (see Vasquez et al. [Phys. Rev. D, 112:063002 (2025)] for the first paper in the series) with the goal of proving the stochastic emission of electrons and positrons, known as the "stochastic charge effect" and first predicted by Page [Phys. Rev. D, 16:2402 (1977)] using semi-classical arguments, arises from quantum electrodynamics (QED) on a Schwarzschild spacetime. We derive the corrections to the $e^\pm$ from the relevant term in the Hamiltonian (the long-range monopole: $H_{\rm int,0L}$) to first order in the fine structure constant ($α$), and show that the semi-classical terms are also present in the QED calculation. We also highlight which terms in our analysis only appear within our quantum mechanical approach and cannot be explained otherwise. We find that due to some cancellation of terms, over the range of $2.2\times 10^{16}$ - $1.7\times 10^{17}$ g, the net correction to the $e^\pm$ emission rate is less than 2%, versus the suppression of up to 5% previously found by semi-classical arguments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在QED框架下严格推导了随机电荷效应导致的e^±发射谱修正，直接关联霍金辐射与天体物理原初黑洞暗物质约束，理论深度高、方法明确（一阶α展开并与半经典结果对比），对黑洞热力学与霍金辐射建模有实质贡献；摘要虽未给出完整推导细节，但研究问题、方法与定量结论清晰，值得深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 小行星质量原初黑洞霍金辐射的修正：随机电荷效应的解析与数值评估
decision.abstract_zh: 霍金辐射基于黑洞产生的蒸发产物，对作为暗物质候选者的原初黑洞（PBHs）在 $M\sim 10^{16}$ g 质量区间给出了严格限制，这促使人们需要严格模拟光子、电子和正电子的发射谱。本文是两篇系列论文中的第二篇（系列第一篇见 Vasquez 等人 [Phys. Rev. D, 112:063002 (2025)]），其目标是证明电子和正电子的随机发射——即所谓“随机电荷效应”，最初由 Page [Phys. Rev. D, 16:2402 (1977)] 用半经典论证预言——源自 Schwarzschild 时空上的量子电动力学（QED）。我们从哈密顿量中的相关项（长程单极项：$H_{\rm int,0L}$）出发，在精细结构常数（$α$）的一阶推导对 $e^\pm$ 的修正，并表明半经典项同样出现在 QED 计算中。我们还着重指出，我们的分析中哪些项只出现在我们的量子力学方法中，而无法用其他方式解释。我们发现，由于一些项的相互抵消，在 $2.2\times 10^{16}$ - $1.7\times 10^{17}$ g 范围内，对 $e^\pm$ 发射率的净修正小于 2%，而此前由半经典论证得到的是高达 5% 的压低。
